verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Browserbase can run thousands of concurrent browser sessions. That is a scaling primitive a developer could use to build a fan-out, not a documented bulk or batch operation applied to many items at once. No batch API, bulk endpoint or multi-item action feature appears in the pack, so this is adjacent support only and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
